### 2026-10-17 – 9:00-1:00

**4h**

9:00-1:00
-Set up onshape and created a new document
- Read through the four links to onshape CAD tutorials
-Learned how to create sketches and use sketch tools

-Got confused over my onshape having the sketch, when the tutorial had a blank page

-Made a helix loop for marble all by my self :) without tutorial guidance.
-Brainstormed and looked at other ideas to make tomorrow from tutorial
